title: Untethered Skies
description: Build your ship, sail the infinite blue, and leave the ground behind. A stylized, airship-focused survival experience featuring trailer-style visuals and a nostalgic C418 soundtrack.
body:
# ☁️ Untethered Skies

> *"Solid ground is nothing but a distant memory. Here, the horizon is infinite, and silence is king."*

**Untethered Skies** is not just a survival modpack. It is a solitary expedition across a fractured world, designed to feel like a nostalgic memory. A visual and auditory experience where the void is not an end, but an ocean to cross.

## ⚓ The Call of the Void

You awake on a drifting islet. The ground below is gone. The sky stretches in every direction, vibrant and bottomless.

Forget static bases. In **Untethered Skies**, your home travels with you. Assemble your ship, hoist the balloons, and take the helm. Your vessel is your only refuge against the immensity.

## 🎨 A "Trailer" Aesthetic

The world has been reimagined to capture the essence of official cinematic trailers.

* **Clean Visuals:** Smooth textures, vibrant colors, and a stylized atmosphere that turns every landscape into a painting.
* **Living Physics:** The wind blows, and lanterns sway at the prow of your ship.
* **The Blue Horizon:** No oppressive black void fog. Just the sky, eternally blue, calling you downwards as well as upwards.

## 🎵 Echoes of the Past

The silence of the skies is broken only by a carefully curated soundtrack. Experience the complete collection of **C418**'s melodies, playing continuously. A permanent nostalgia that accompanies every swing of the pickaxe and every sunset.

---

### 📜 Captain's Log

* **Immersion:** This modpack is designed to be experienced. Turn off the HUD (F1), take a breath, and watch the clouds pass.
* **Visuals:** Shaders are highly recommended (and included) to get the intended look of the screenshots.

*Fair winds, traveler.*
